We've also seen this sporadically on deployments to our various environments, were we temporarily had to disable Hibernate schema validation. But is was most notably happening on CI. 

I do suspect that it's a timing issue somehow, that the Hibernate validation kicks in just before Flyway was able to run the migrations.

N.B. the Hibernate ORM extension is booting Hibernate in a secondary thread; this was done out of concerns that booting it was potentially going to take a long time. I don't remember the details, just a suggestion as to what to look into :)

AFAIR there's some form of latch ensuring this is fully completed before Quarkus is considered booted, but I guess this latch might not be fully in synch with expectations of other extensions which manage the schema.
